title: Apple TV co-op multi controller Pong game
author: Nuvolore
selftext:
Weekend project with my kid, we wanted a game we could play together:

Prompt I gave the coding agent using T3 Code mobile:  
“I want to play old school Pong using 2 controllers on my Apple TV with my son, make it look neon style with ton of effects and powerups. XCode is setup and Apple TV is paired. Build and deploy it.”

This is us playing a bit later directly from the Apple TV with the app automatically installed by the agent.

The part that it handled the multi controllers in one shot particularly blew my mind!

comments.author: ElioVibe
comments.body:
That's one of the few games here that seems potentially successful.

No slop bad optimized meshes changes everything
